clearance_observer.source: Actual static mesh render LOD0 vertices from GeometryScript, component world transform
clearance_observer.eligibility: Lowest vertex >=10cm above horizontal tabletop; tilt<=15degrees; speed<=10cm/s; gravity and simulation on; no attachment; both flat pad overlaps and no other supports
clearance_observer.continuous_hold: Resets on failed criterion or observation gap>300ms
clearance_observer.contact_limit: Geometric overlap snapshot, not native solver impulse ledger; grasp_verified remains false pending review
